VitalRAG

Agentic Health-Document RAG Copilot

PythonFastAPIQdrantLLM APIsMem0

A health-document copilot combining semantic vector search with a document summary index for reasoning across multiple documents. A tool-calling agent chooses retrieval tools and persistent memory, with clarification guardrails when evidence is insufficient.

Cross-session memory retains user context. Retrieval accuracy, latency, and per-query cost were benchmarked across 20+ test queries.

CONCEPT VISUAL · TRAFFIC SIMULATION
02 / APPLIED INTELLIGENCE

Intelligent Transportation System

PythonFastAPISUMOpandasJavaScript

A transportation simulation system with a FastAPI backend for processing vehicle trajectory data and visualizing transit simulations.

Ant Colony Optimization dynamically computes low-congestion routes, outperforming Dijkstra by up to 22% in congestion-heavy simulations. Particle Swarm Optimization adjusts traffic signal timings, with 88% accuracy reported in test simulations.

CONCEPT VISUAL · VIDEO TRANSCRIPT RAG
03 / RETRIEVAL & LEARNING

Course Study Assistant

Advanced Video-Transcript RAG

Node.jsLangGraphQdrantPostgreSQLCohere

A LangGraph-orchestrated study assistant for 87 React Native and Expo lessons across 18 modules. Timestamp-aware ingestion brings subtitles, PDFs, JSON, and Markdown into one retrieval pipeline.

Hybrid search combines query expansion, HyDE, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and reranking. Lesson-order filtering and timestamped citations keep answers relevant, while an LLM grader retries weakly grounded responses.
